$description: EDH Seer's chart and graph colours, extracted from the shipped theme. The categorical palette is NOT an abstract eight-series ramp: this product visualises Magic, so its categories are the five colours of mana, and a sixth series does not exist to be coloured.

mana.$description: DATA VISUALISATION ONLY, never UI. Identity in the interface uses real mana symbols in Wizards' own colours; this ramp exists only where an identity has to become a fill or a stroke and a symbol cannot be placed (the graph's colour-identity mode, chart series). Tuned for THIS ground, not copied from the cards.

u.$description: L 70.6% C 0.138 H 259.5 - brighter and cooler than the card blue, which sat too close to the violet ladder and muddied against panel fills

b.$description: L 58.7% C 0.017 - a TRUE NEUTRAL GREY, not a charcoal-violet, which on this ground would read as 'slightly darker substrate' instead of as a colour. The one place a pure neutral is correct here, precisely because it is the absence of the cast around it.

categorical.$description: The default series order when a chart's categories are not identities. Five steps, because five is what the game has.

series.$description: A single-series chart takes the fill, not a categorical step: the bar IS the substrate. See colors.json semantic.data.

edge.$description: opacity carries edge WEIGHT, so this is the strong end and weak edges fade from it

diverging.$description: Signed synergy runs -5..+5, so a diverging scale is the one this product actually needs. Neutral is a ladder step, not a grey.

label.$description: set at tokens/typography.json fontSize.2xs (10px), the documented micro step
